objectives: Explain why Jacob kept Benjamin home.
Describe how Joseph tested his brethren and how their conscience was activated.
takeaways: In famine the fathers moved toward Egypt for sustenance; it is a repeating thing in our history.
Benjamin was the last son Jacob had of Rachel, so he would not let him go down.
Joseph knew his brethren, but they knew him not; and he remembered the dreams.
We are verily guilty concerning our brother: their conscience was activated.
Joseph understood every word through the interpreter, turned aside and wept, then bound Simeon.
